name: Consumables
description: Items normally consumed or exhausted through use

fields.description: Clean cloth and basic supplies for treating wounds.
A general treatment granting another chance to resist ordinary poison.
Creates a dense cloud of smoke when ignited.
A limited dose of toxin suitable for one weapon or drink.
Grants clear sight in darkness for one hour.
Allows underwater breathing for thirty minutes.
A carefully sealed vial able to damage common materials.
A stabilized vial that aids recovery from an injury when used correctly.
A drink briefly improving physical ability before causing severe fatigue.
A single-use medium containing {{ rules.name }}; its exact effect and interpretation remain with the GM.
A small batch of projectiles made for a particular weapon or unusual target.
A fragile, hard-to-replace treatment for one specific illness.
A measured packet that produces a sudden burst of light when ignited.
A bitter dose intended to induce a deep but ordinary sleep.
Mineral salts used to clean wounds, tools, water, or ritual spaces.
A sealed refill sufficient for several hours of steady light.
A prepared oil consumed when coating one object for a GM-defined purpose.
A wrapped herbal preparation applied once to soothe pain and swelling.
